instrumental indicating division into two portions
compound indicating conjunction or mixture with gold

items.question: What division and coloration define the prescribed white-mountain form?
premises: The white-mountain form is divided into two parts.
One aspect of this form is joined with gold.
The resulting form is characterized as white-colored.
items.inference: The prescribed white-mountain form consists of two parts combined with gold while retaining a white coloration.
uncertainties: The exact spatial distribution of gold within the two parts is not specified.
items.plain_english: The white mountain is to be understood as divided into two parts, joined with gold, and white in color.
